name: Bloody Game
description: Ten players, 300 million KRW prize money! The last survivor of the game will take the money. Contestants from diverse backgrounds compete for survival in this brutal game, in which whatever means necessary are allowed. You can enjoy the complicated mind games as the contestants do politics, tell lies, design plots, or anything that can help them survive.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: This is a survival game where ten players have to compete against each other for the prize money. Ten players participate in the very unfair and irrational game to win the prize money. The first challenge to test the players' survival skills is revealed. One of the players will be eliminated through a vote.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Na Yeong folds pizza boxes in the basement not knowing what time it is while the other players on the ground are enjoying pizzas. Ji Min, Seo Hyun, and Queen WASABII wonder who they should team up with. The players play Distribution Game. As the game progresses, anxiety amongst the players rise since they can't fully trust each other.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: This week's Money Challenge is Expression Game. There are number cards and operation cards outside, and the players must go around the place and find the hidden cards. With the cards they have, they have to complete an expression to get 43. Meanwhile, Yeon Seung and Na Yeong want to find a way to go upstairs, however, it's not as easy as they think.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The players play a game of trust consisting of five rounds. Meanwhile, the players on the basement floor guess the winner of today's game, winning a prize if their guess is right.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The players are determined to use every means to win the games. Meanwhile, the players on the basement floor desperately want to go up to the ground floor.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Money Challenge for this episode is Asset Game. The players on the basement floor participate in this game as Player X. Another Elimination Vote happens, causing self-doubt to creep into the players.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The players on the ground floor and basement floor finally clash in a head-to-head challenge. The outcome of this challenge could change the whole game.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The second team competition between Team Ground and Team Basement begins. Today's Money Challenge is Strategy Expression Game. This time, no one wants to lose.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Disagreements and adversity threaten to break apart the two teams. The last team competition between the ground floor and basement floor starts.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The basement closes and the semi-final begins with an outcome that could change everything.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The remaining four players compete in Final Match.  The top four players try hard to beat each other while playing mind games. Who will emerge victorious in this ruthless game?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After the end of Bloody Game last week, the players gather up at the studio for a special review session of the show. They go over the key moments that happened throughout the show and talk about each situation. Hidden scenes that were not aired on the show get revealed as well. Stay tuned for the final episode of Bloody Game!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Bloody Game returns with its second season. The new contestants get unveiled after getting released from their blindfolds. The first game begins right away with the contestants tied up to a chair in the middle of nowhere. Cruelly enough, one person will get eliminated before even getting a chance to stay at the Bloody Mansion. Stay tuned!

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Four mysterious players are captured and tied up in a dungeon. They're the hidden players who are given a different set of rules to play. They must survive in the survival zone with bare necessities. One of them can enter the mansion and play as their spy until the Day of Ambush. On the Day of Ambush, they can drive out the other players and take over the mansion. Will they be able to survive in the wild until then?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Yurisa starts threatening the other players to her advantage. The players search the house to unlock the secret of Pandora's box. The outside team anxiously waits for good news from their spy.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: An ejected player shares useful information with the hidden players. Thanks to his tips, the hidden players get to plan what they will do once they are inside the mansion. The Day of Ambush arrives, and the mansion players do their best to guard the symbols of the mansion. The hidden players move swiftly, but it's hard to get past Seung Jin and KNUCKS, the strongest players.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The Day of Ambush brings many changes. The Indoor Team and Outdoor Team's team game begins. The poker players of each team, Jin Ho and Sung Joo have an intense battle of brains against each other.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Outdoor Team raids the mansion. They replenish their energy with the food they stole. The second team battle occurs in the wild. It's Arithmetic Expression Road, where they must complete an expression board with number cards and operation cards. KNUCKS is confident that his team will win. Xitsuh and Jin Ho play a crucial role in their team. Which team will be the winner of the battle?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The first individual game, Real Time, starts. It's an individual game, but the players divide themselves into teams to gain an advantage. The loser can choose their opponent for the Deathmatch. The winner of the game becomes the Ruler, giving them the ability to kick a player out of the mansion.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: For the next Money Challenge, Color Turn, the players must pair up to gain an advantage, causing an upset in previous alliances.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Seung Jin plans a shocking strategy to turn the tables. The Wild Alliance gets taken aback by his strategy. How effective will his new strategy be?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The players keep switching their alliances, which makes Day and Night, the new Money Challenge, even more confusing. What strategy will Dex come up with to avoid being in last place?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The Wild Alliance comes apart, leading to the start of a new alliance. A cruel atmosphere continues as yesterday's teammate becomes today's enemy.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The players participate in the last Money Challenge before the semi-finals.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: It's the final day when the final winner gets decided. Who will become the last man standing?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The footage of the players that we've never seen before is shared. Pi shows off her hidden talent at Phantom Casino. Dex's bets frustrate Jin Ho. The kittens of the mansion who stole the players' hearts are revealed.

videos.title: Welcome to the Bloody Game.
videos.overview: The extreme survival competition has begun again. Who will go straight to the first death match.

videos.title: It's God's destiny.
videos.overview: Mysterious players gathered in an unknown mansion. In silence, they start looking for today's scapegoat...

videos.title: We need to eliminate strong people
videos.overview: Money Challenge started with suspicious whereabouts left behind. Who is the king of mystery games?

videos.title: I can't live without losing
videos.overview: People who haven't returned. Unnerved players go into defensive position.

videos.title: Every choice must come at a cost
videos.overview: The day of the attack finally came. Paradise and debris fully prepared. Who is the winner of this war?

videos.title: The energy of the universe came to us
videos.overview: Players divided into three teams. The first team match begins with each team's pride.

videos.title: I don't have any more fears
videos.overview: Jang Dong-min vs. Kim Kyung-ran vs. Hong Jin-ho. Who is the winner of the 4th round that started with a lot of tension?

videos.title: To be in the same boat
videos.overview: Seeds of doubt spread by someone. The relationship between players who have become unable to trust each other gradually descends into catastrophe.

videos.title: There is no eternal demilitarized zone
videos.overview: A 15 man solo exhibition over a powerhouse position. There are players who have declared a gray zone with their respective coalitions...

videos.title: Being born is the most important thing
videos.overview: The losing team has to go to the rubble. 7vs6 team match with fear and tension. Which winning team in this match needs memory and reasoning?

videos.title: I just let go of what I was holding
videos.overview: Defeated team driven to the rubble. Feeling like a cliffhanger, Hong Jin-ho brings his players together with one decision.

videos.title: God lied to me
videos.overview: Aa-ger and Seongbeom start to collide. They start the game with distrust for each other...

videos.title: You have to pour everything you've built up so far
videos.overview: Ahead of the final individual match heading into the final match, Jang Dong-min and Hong Jin-ho make secret contact.

videos.title: Let's start the final match
videos.overview: Two players join the final match. Who will be the final winner of Bloody Game 3.
